validated_results.title: Vitamin D deficiency alters prostate epithelial differentiation and increases prostate cancer aggressiveness in ex vivo and in vivo models.
validated_results.reason: The study examines vitamin D deficiency exclusively in mouse prostate organoids, mice fed deficient diets, and human prostate cancer cell lines/xenografts, with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Consumption of ultra-processed foods and increased risks of prostate cancer in a random sample of United States adults.
validated_results.reason: The analysis is a cross-sectional NHANES comparison of self-reported existing prostate cancer, so it measures prevalence rather than incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: The selenium and vitamin E cancer prevention trial (SELECT): a secondary, post-intervention analysis on potential excess chronic disease incidence induced by selenium administration.
validated_results.reason: This post-intervention SELECT analysis reports long-term risks for lung, hematologic, colorectal, melanoma and neurodegenerative outcomes but provides no prostate cancer incidence result.
